title: #415 – Serhii Plokhy: History of Ukraine, Russia, Soviet Union, KGB, Nazis & War
summary: Serhii Plokhy is a Ukrainian historian at Harvard University, director of the Ukrainian Research Institute, and an author of many books on history of Eastern Europe, including his latest book The Russo-Ukrainian War: The Return of History.
